summary: A composable, accessibility-focused headless library with a small install (about 18 MB with React 19), MIT licensing, provenance and a dialog spike at 253.93 KB / 81.67 KB gzip. It is held because it is still 0.x and has a smaller component catalogue than React Aria or Base UI.
reasoning: Active release line: 0.4.42 published 2026-10-14; repository pushed 2026-11-03; 8.6k stars and 49 open issues.
MIT with a permissive tree and no required CSS runtime.
npm provenance is present via GitHub Actions trusted publishing.
No install scripts and no recorded OSV advisories.
The React 19 dialog spike opened with role=dialog, labelledby, describedby and focus inside.
The bundle was 253.93 KB / 81.67 KB gzip; about 18 MB installed with React 19.
The package is still 0.x and has a smaller catalogue than React Aria; use it for composable primitives when its API fits.
caveats: Smaller component catalogue than React Aria or Base UI.
No local spike for complex widgets beyond the dialog.
Use @ariakit/react, not the deprecated ariakit package.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT; the isolated tree is MIT.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies react/react-dom: ^17 || ^18 || ^19. The spike used React 19.2.0.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 1 runtime dependency; about 18 MB installed with React 19; 1.1 MB unpacked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA provenance is present on 0.4.42; npm records GitHub Actions as the publisher via a trusted publisher.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered an open dialog in Chrome 1200x800 with role=dialog, labelledby, describedby and focus inside. The JS bundle was 253.93 KB / 81.67 KB gzip including React 19.

evidence.label: Component coverage
evidence.detail: Composable primitives with a smaller catalogue than React Aria or Base UI.
